purpose: Crash-safe restart cursor after transport interruption.
timeout_recovery_algorithm: Read CURRENT_STATE, then CURRENT_INFLIGHT, then this pointer.
Resume from first missing committed phase; do not rerun durable compute solely because message delivery failed.
Official compute requires committed producer bytes and exact local Git-blob verification.
Persist result, report, workbook readback and manifest before advancing CURRENT_STATE.
Require DELTA rebuild artifact gate success.

execution_hardening.large_stdout_policy: Persist detailed diagnostics to JSON; keep transport output compact.
execution_hardening.phase_checkpoint_policy: Update CURRENT_INFLIGHT and recovery pointer immediately after each durable phase so browser transport timeout cannot force recompute.
